select g.id, g.group_name, g.group_code, g.default_target_user_id, u.user_code as default_target_user_code, u.user_name as default_target_user_name from mes_msg_group g inner join mes_msg_user u on g.default_target_user_id = u.id
g.deleted_flag = '0' and u.deleted_flag = '0'
and g.group_name like concat('%', #{param.groupName}, '%')
and g.group_code like concat('%', #{param.groupCode}, '%')
and g.id = #{param.id}
order by g.update_time desc

select g.id, g.group_name, g.group_code from mes_msg_group g
g.deleted_flag = '0'
and (g.group_name like concat('%', #{groupName}, '%') or g.group_code like concat ('%', #{groupName}, '%'))
and g.id = #{id}
order by g.update_time desc
